title: MemSteer: Turning User Histories into Supervision for Agent Memory Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2610.39276v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: An effective agent memory system should adapt to a user's history and task requirements. Human-annotated supervision can guide this adaptation by providing feedback for evaluating and improving memory designs. Yet suitable labels are rarely available for new user histories, and manually constructing QA pairs and supporting evidence is costly. We introduce MemSteer, which turns unlabeled user histories into question-answer (QA) supervision with supporting evidence for memory-design optimization. MemSteer constructs an evidence-grounded answer plan that specifies how facts across related records jointly support a reference answer. translated_title: MemSteer：将用户历史转化为智能体记忆优化的监督信号
translated_abstract: 一个有效的智能体记忆系统应当能够适应用户的历史和任务需求。人工标注的监督可以通过提供反馈来评估和改进记忆设计，从而指导这种适应。然而，对于新的用户历史，合适的标注往往难以获得，而人工构建问答对及其支持证据的成本很高。我们提出MemSteer，它将无标注的用户历史转化为带有支持证据的问答监督，用于记忆设计的优化。MemSteer构建了一个基于证据的答案计划，明确说明相关记录中的事实如何共同支持一个参考答案。该计划指导问题生成，同时通过基于来源的审计和盲答案恢复来检验生成的标注。为了研究这种监督的效用，我们开发了MemSteer-Opt，它将基于问答的设计评估与证据引导的失败诊断相结合，用于修订记忆存储、检索等组件。
tldr: MemSteer提出了一种将无标注用户历史自动转化为带证据支持的问答监督的方法，并结合证据引导的失败诊断来优化智能体记忆系统的设计。
en_tdlr: MemSteer automatically converts unlabeled user histories into evidence-grounded QA supervision and leverages evidence-guided failure diagnosis to optimize agent memory system design.
